Documentation and Requirements:
- Must be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit or have a fiscal sponsor
- Must serve communities in New York State
- Must provide culturally and linguistically responsive services

3. Workforce training
4. Educational advancement

- Must submit required organizational documents (IRS determination letter, budget, etc.)
- Programs should support underserved and/or Latino communities and improve socioeconomic outcomes.
